title: Human mutation field reveals an equilibrium-like structure with irreversible circulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07500v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The evolution of DNA sequences can be viewed as stochastic dynamics on a high-dimensional discrete space, but it is unclear when empirical transition biases reduce to an effective energy landscape versus retain irreducible non-equilibrium circulation. Human context-dependent mutation probabilities offer a direct test: every single-nucleotide substitution in a local context has a reverse substitution, so the logarithm of the forward-to-reverse probability ratio defines an antisymmetric field-the human mutation field. We show this field has a dominant gradient component and a smaller but reproducible curl component. Using seven-base human germline substitution probabilities, we infer an effective mutational landscape with a Siamese neural network constrained to predict only energy differences. translated_title: 人类突变场揭示了一种具有不可逆环流的类平衡结构
translated_abstract: DNA序列的演化可以被视为高维离散空间上的随机动力学，但目前尚不清楚经验性的转移偏倚何时能简化为有效的能量景观，何时会保留不可约化的非平衡环流。人类上下文依赖的突变概率为此提供了一个直接的检验：局部上下文中的每一个单核苷酸替换都存在对应的反向替换，因此正向与反向替换概率之比的对数定义了一个反对称场——即人类突变场。我们证明该场具有一个占主导地位的梯度分量和一个较小但可重复再现的旋度分量。利用七碱基的人类种系替换概率，我们通过一个被约束为仅预测能量差的孪生神经网络推断出有效的突变景观。该模型对留出测试突变的前向-反向对数比的预测相关性约为0.93，接近无约束预测模型的水平……
tldr: 该研究定义了“人类突变场”，发现其以梯度分量（类平衡结构）为主导，同时存在较小但可重复的旋度分量（不可逆环流），并利用仅预测能量差的孪生神经网络成功推断出有效的突变能量景观，预测相关性高达约0.93。
en_tdlr: This study defines a "human mutation field" that exhibits a dominant gradient (equilibrium-like) component alongside a smaller reproducible curl component representing irreversible circulation, and successfully infers an effective mutational energy landscape using a Siamese neural network with a predictive correlation of about 0.93.
